6: # Prep build environment

8: COPY . /tmp/workdir

11: # Build kayenta

13: # container to talk to a Kayenta instance, which requires some Docker shenanigans.
14: RUN gradle assemble

17: RUN tar -xf /tmp/workdir/kayenta-web/build/distributions/kayenta.tar -C /opt
